text: Gotcha (from the DAS Bingo engineer): apps/web/src/arcade/arcade.css defines a global `.room { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none }` that collides with the shell's `.room` wrapper in shell/RoomScreen.tsx, so every lobby/game room becomes unclickable (e.g. 'Start game' is intercepted by #root). The arcade room class needs a unique prefix.
